title: Proposal: working together on SYNGAP1-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into SYNGAP1-related disorders.
We are writing to CURE SYNGAP1 because you support families affected by SYNGAP1-related disorders.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work links the disorders to haploinsufficiency and loss of function, though the atlas gives these links only moderate confidence.
An STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 natural history study is recruiting, and people are included in Simons Searchlight, Citizen Health and RARE-X.
A pilot fenfluramine trial across several encephalopathies has completed.
The ENDD Center at Penn and CHOP works on SYNGAP1 therapeutics and shared models.
The link to DEE-P Connections is only a partnership signal, not a formal membership record.
We would propose a study on [research question about SYNGAP1-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your community or the natural history study might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
